PDFjet.NET

Class Image

  • Object
    • PDFjet.NET.Image
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    IDrawable

    public final class Image
extends Object
implements IDrawable
    Used to create image objects and draw them on a page. The image type can be one of the following: ImageType.JPG, ImageType.PNG or ImageType.BMP Please see Example_03 and Example_24.
